prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production environment backdrop for an interactive Vietnamese xianxia RPG Settings and account panel.
Primary request: premium hand-painted dark navy Chinese cultivation temple at night, inspired by the settings screen reference. Only environment illustration, no UI.
Scene: an elegant lantern-lit mountain temple gate and tall pagoda roof in the far RIGHT THIRD, warm golden lanterns, a slim stairway, subtle pink peach blossom branches framing top right, distant deep-blue mountains and a small moon. LEFT TWO THIRDS are very dark ink-blue mist with soft unobtrusive texture and generous negative space for real account information. Painterly fantasy game art, refined navy, antique gold, desaturated blue and tiny pink accents. Landscape 3:2, full bleed. Rich illustrated detail on the right edge only, readable low-contrast background everywhere else.
Constraints: no people, no words, no lettering, no symbols, no logos, no watermark, no frames, no buttons or interface.
reference: User-supplied Settings screen: visual style, environment, navy/gold palette and account-card composition. Functional UI rendered in React/CSS; unsupported audio, gift-code and external account-link systems are not simulated.
